long_biography.plain_text:
A polo fundraiser introduced Steven Savor to the volunteers behind the Fort Lauderdale International Film Festival, beginning a lasting commitment to its work. Welcomed by the Entre Nous organisers, he became a regular host and sponsor of festival events. He helped expand their polo fundraiser from a small gathering into an event attracting hundreds of guests.

His gift to the festival's flagship cinema in 2016 included funds to renovate the building and surrounding grounds, alongside a cash donation. The theatre was renamed Savor Cinema. His donations also enabled the festival to organise charity benefits and offer complimentary admission to Florida-based women filmmakers in 2018.
